nasa.timestamp_interpretation: fixed UTC-04:00 offset recorded in the log; output timestamps are UTC
nasa.duplicate_policy: Each valid log record is one request. Equal timestamps are concurrent requests and are not deduplicated.
nasa.missing_policy: All complete calendar bins between the first and final partial bin are retained; bins without records are zero requests. No interpolation.
nasa.target: HTTP request count per complete 5-minute bin

paper_protocol_clue.interpretation: These equal the public repository's approximately 3.46 million requests and exactly 16,364 samples, suggesting nonempty-bin aggregation. We do not adopt that irregular-gap sequence because exact paper split/horizon/zero handling remain unknown.

alibaba.selection_rule: Earliest longest exact 10-second run for which every timestamp has at least 20 valid observations from complete named container blocks.
alibaba.missing_policy: No missing timestamp is filled and no absent container is treated as zero. Only exact source timestamps are averaged.
alibaba.duplicate_policy: At most one contribution per container/timestamp; duplicate rows would be averaged before the cross-container mean.
alibaba.target: mean cpu_util_percent among valid observed complete-prefix containers at each exact source timestamp
alibaba.scope_limitation: Observed-container mean from a nonrandom prefix, not whole-cluster CPU demand and not an individual-container series.
